fullContentHtml:
RRB Paramedical Syllabus 2026 - Check Exam Pattern, Selection Process & Subject-Wise Topics - Complete Details

Check the RRB Paramedical Syllabus 2026 with full CBT exam pattern, marking scheme, selection process, and subject-wise topics for Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, Radiographer and other posts, plus preparation tips and FAQs.

Important Dates

  • RRB Paramedical Exam Date 2026 : 10th, 11th and 12th March 2026
  • Mode of Exam : Online (Computer Based Test)
  • Duration of Exam : 90 minutes

Application Fee

  • Posts : Various Paramedical Staff Posts
  • Number of Questions : 100
  • General Awareness : 10
  • General Arithmetic, General Intelligence and Reasoning : 10
  • General Science : 10
  • OBC (NCL) : 30%
  • SC : 30%
  • ST : 25%
  • Post : Key Syllabus Topics
  • Staff Nurse : Anatomy, Physiology, Nutrition, Biochemistry, Nursing Foundations, Psychology, Microbiology, Sociology, Pharmacology, Pathology, Genetics, Medical-Surgical Nursing, Community Health Nursing, Child Health Nursing, Mental Health Nursing, Midwifery and Obstetrical Nursing, Nursing Research and Statistics, Management of Nursing Services
  • Pharmacist Grade III : Human Anatomy and Physiology, Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry (Organic and Inorganic), Biochemistry and Pathophysiology, Pharmacology, Pharmacognosy and Phytochemistry, Industrial Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Jurisprudence, Biopharmaceutics and Pharmacokinetics, Quality Assurance, Pharmacy Practice
  • Physiotherapist : Anatomy, Physiology, Applied Physiology, Biomechanics, Exercise Therapy, Electrotherapy (low, medium and high frequency), Clinical Orthopaedics, Community Medicine, Clinical Cardio-Respiratory Diseases, Rehabilitation Medicine, Bio-Statistics and Research Methodology
  • Dental Hygienist : Dental Hygiene and Oral Prophylaxis, Community Health Dentistry, Operative Room Technique and Chairside Assistance, Dental Materials, Dental Ethics and Jurisprudence, Anatomy and Physiology (General and Dental/Oral), Dental Radiology
  • Optometrist : Physical and Geometrical Optics, General and Ocular Anatomy/Physiology, Optometric Optics, Ocular Diseases, Pharmacology, Visual Optics, Binocular Vision, Glaucoma, Low Vision Aids, Contact Lens, Public Health and Community Optometry
  • Perfusionist : Anatomy, Physiology and Biochemistry Basics, Instrumentation and Measurements, Perfusion Techniques, Applied Perfusion Technology, Cardio-Pulmonary Bypass, Oxygenators, Perfusion Equipment, Biomedical Electronics, Postoperative Intensive Care Management
  • Speech Therapist : Sound and Hearing, Anatomy and Physiology of the Ear, Hearing Loss Evaluation, Speech and Language Pathology, Disorders of Speech and Language, Hearing Aids and Earmolds, Rehabilitation, Management of Speech and Language Disorders
  • Lab Assistant Grade III : Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Fundamentals of Medical Laboratory Technology, Microbiology, Clinical Biochemistry, Pathology and Histopathology, Hematology and Blood Bank
